notes: Body material ext_body, txDiffuse ext_body_Mixed_AO.dds (2048x2048). The body is one mesh (222_T), so placement uses the generic side zone plus UV island selection to pick the door panel rather than the fender or quarter. Factory skins colour the car through cm_skin.json carPaint; generation bakes that colour into the diffuse and sets carPaint.enabled false.
